description: A test suite for the AgentWorkspace component, verifying behaviors such as path display, URL resolution, bootstrap process, and safety checks within workspace directories.

methods.name: display path uses tilde for home
methods.description: Tests that the displayPath method correctly displays the home directory using a tilde.

methods.name: resolve workspace URL expands tilde
methods.description: Ensures that resolveWorkspaceURL correctly expands '~' to the full path.

methods.name: agents URL appends filename
methods.description: Verifies that agentsURL appends the correct filename to the workspace URL.

methods.name: bootstrap creates agents file when missing
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap creates necessary agent files and returns the correct URL when the workspace is missing those files.

methods.name: bootstrap safety rejects non empty folder without agents
methods.description: Tests that bootstrapSafety rejects a directory that contains unrelated files and no agents file.

methods.name: bootstrap safety allows existing agents file
methods.description: Verifies that bootstrapSafety allows a workspace that already contains an agents file.

methods.name: bootstrap skips bootstrap file when workspace has content
methods.description: Ensures that bootstrap does not overwrite existing bootstrap files if the workspace contains other content.

methods.name: needs bootstrap false when identity already set
methods.description: Checks that needsBootstrap returns false when the identity file already exists with valid content.
